scope: Test-only serialized request observer supporting G05-A11/G06-A07; never full privacy acceptance

checks.procedure: Three in-memory ordinary-node requests containing known human address respectively in RPC id, dynamic params object key, request X-Account header
checks.observed: Each forwarded once and produced requestCoverageComplete:true, roles:[]

checks.procedure: Original transport returns actual resolved Promise with throwing own constructor getter; wrapper called normally
checks.observed: Wrapper synchronously throws and does not return original Promise; observation attachment changed behavior

findings.scenario: RPC IDs, parameter object keys and request headers bypass observation and unsupported counters; known human values can reach ordinary-node while complete/no-role is reported. Raw L1 transaction serialization and unsafe numeric JSON leaves also lack incomplete classification.
findings.repair: Boundedly observe the relevant serialized components without persisting raw data, or explicitly mark unsupported/incomplete. Treat encoded L1 raw transactions opaque pending separate decoded evidence; flag unsupported numeric values. Add the three actual reproduced no-role false-complete cases and opaque/unsafe negatives.

findings.scenario: Promise.prototype.then attachment invokes Promise species/constructor machinery outside a guard; a throwing constructor getter replaces original return with synchronous observer error. Promise detection can likewise throw on hostile object.
findings.repair: Guard post-call result detection/attachment, retain original result identity and record an observer coverage gap; preserve original synchronous throw identity. Regression actual Promise getter and unsupported proxy/thenable boundaries.

positiveChecks: Original arguments/receiver/ordinary native Promise and response identity preserved in existing real-loopback test; response body remains caller-owned.
Fixed endpoint/method/phase rows and HMAC-in-memory scalar relationship aggregates, no raw identities or salt persisted.
Bounded requests/body/JSON traversal/relations; explicit unknown and opaque node transaction gaps and external inventory/ingress requirements.
Actual public reader and prover health routing exercised without real wallet/proof campaign.
limitations: No private witness, real user, model call, proof, browser, Docker or cloud operation performed.
Full actual transport inventory, receiver positive controls, decoded public effects and deployed trust boundary remain parent-owned acceptance.
